title: Northwood Space raises $375M Series C at a $2B valuation from a16z and DFJ Growth
slides: Can Northwood Space turn satellite data into a utility?
It just raised $375M at a $2B valuation.
But the real bet is on ground infrastructure, not satellites.
Companies ignoring this shift risk missing cheaper data access.
Watch for their first commercial ground station launch this year.
thread_text:
1. $2B for ground stations

Northwood Space just raised $375M to build ground infrastructure, not satellites. The real bet is on the pipes, not the data.

2. Satellites are the easy part

Ground stations are the bottleneck. Northwood wants to turn them into a utility—cheaper access for everyone.

3. Ignore this at your peril

Companies stuck on old ground infrastructure will pay more for data. The shift to shared ground stations cuts costs.

4. First launch this year

Northwood's first commercial ground station goes live. That's the proof point—watch if it delivers.

5. Are you ready to switch?

Check your current data costs. If Northwood's utility model works, you could save. Ask your provider about ground station options.
